title: Instinct: the trained add-on composes on top of the free floor
intro: Press play to walk the composition one step at a time, or click a dot to jump. Each step shows what goes in and what comes out — captured from the real release binary where the step is live.

walk.title: The same typed question
walk.text: Your app sends the same typed question it would send the free engine: a state plus questions — choice, score or yes-no. This spot question is one the game heads know.

in.label: POST /decide
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (answered request)

walk.title: The free floor answers first
walk.text: Reflex runs before anything paid: embed, route to the corpus, score every option, and the fused gate checks confidence. On this harder triage question the gate abstains — every outcome comes back null — and that abstain is what pays the rung above.

in.label: POST /decide · a harder question

out.label: not sure: the abstain that pays the rung
out.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (abstained response)

walk.title: Sure — the specialist is never paid
walk.text: When the floor is sure, the answer goes straight back with calibrated confidence and a receipt, and no specialist is consulted. That is the rung model: you pay for thinking, never for re-answering what the free floor already knows.

out.label: sure: outcome yes

walk.title: Prune to the candidates
walk.text: Only the abstained question goes on. The survivors are pruned to the top candidates so the rung above scores a handful of options, not the whole list.

walk.title: The specialist scores
walk.text: A per-domain specialist — a locked artifact whose digest is checked at every load — scores the candidates. Selection is a monotonic hot-swap of whole artifacts from the manifest: never a weighted blend, because blends do not preserve rankings.

walk.title: Fuse into one calibrated answer
walk.text: The composition fuses the floor's read with the specialist's: a cascade pick, or prior fusion lifting the calibrated favourite. A confident pick returns as the answer, receipt attached.

walk.title: Still unsure — one rung deeper
walk.text: Where the bag view reads too coarse, a trained encoder head thinks — GPU-hosted, weights on our hosts only. It is measured on the benchmark board today, record-only: the hosted lane opens later, and this is the public request it would carry.

in.label: the abstained question, sent up
in.from: captured from the reflex 0.2.4 release binary, 2026-10-03 · POST /decide (abstained request)

walk.title: The manifest hot-swaps arms
walk.text: arsenal.toml is the one selection surface: a specialist joins only where it beat free Reflex on one frozen test read, and it is swapped whole — a decision always observes one whole server.
